§6Plutonium-239§f

§aThe weapons-grade one. Best for warheads and high-strength fuel.§f

Pu-239 is the most valuable plutonium isotope, a neutron capture product of §bU-238§f in nuclear reactors.

Properties: §e5.0§f RAD/s, §e44.4%§f of raw plutonium, fissile category.

Production: neutron capture of U-238 in reactors. Often found mixed with Pu-240, which is a problem if you need pure Pu-239.

Uses: Plutonium Fuel, MOX Fuel, all thermonuclear warheads using plutonium cores, Mini-Nuke weapons (nuggets only), and contributes an impressive §e25§f to the custom nuke.

Breeds into Pu-240 (disappointing isotope).

§ePS:§f Pure Pu-239 is essential for high-yield warheads. Use the SILEX to separate it from Pu-240. Reactor-bred plutonium always has some Pu-240 contamination.
